name: att-trace-viewer
description: View ROCm Advanced Thread Trace (ATT) in a VS Code webview timeline

commands.title: ATT Viewer: Open ATT Trace (from file)

attViewer.pythonPath.description: Python executable to run the offline ATT decoder

attViewer.maxEvents.description: Cap decoded instruction events (0 = all, with automatic safety cap on very large traces). Use this to speed up large traces.

attViewer.rocprofilerSdkPath.description: Path to librocprofiler-sdk.so used for ATT decoding

attViewer.llvmObjdumpPath.description: Path to llvm-objdump used for disassembly in the source panel

attViewer.hipSourceSnapshotOnly.description: When true, the HIP pane reads only rocprof capture snapshots and never falls back to the compile-time path on disk. Leave false for normal development: missing headers (common for DWARF-only inlining) are read from disk and optionally copied into the capture.

attViewer.hipAutoSnapshotFill.description: When falling back to the compile-time path, copy the file into ui_output_*/source_*_<basename> so later opens and other machines use the snapshot. Run bench/att_fill_sources.py after capture to batch-fill existing traces.
